## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Orange Interior?
TS 137, opp. to Fire Station, Thiru Vi Ka Industrial Estate, SIDCO Industrial Estate, Guindy, Chennai 600 032.

### What facilities does Orange Interior have?
Home interiors, Modular kitchens, Wardrobes & lofts, Living & bedroom interiors, Office interiors, Commercial & showroom interiors, False ceilings, Space planning & 3D rendering, Turnkey projects, Open all week, 9 am – 9 pm.

### Do you do offices as well as homes?
Yes. Orange Interior designs and executes homes, offices and commercial spaces, as turnkey projects.
